Jharkhand High Court lifts stay on JPSC Civil Service PT results

The Jharkhand High Court has concluded hearings on a dispute concerning the age limit for the JPSC Civil Service Preliminary exam. The court's decision effectively clears the path for the release of the JPSC PT 2026 results. This ruling is expected to provide relief to candidates who had applied based on the 2022 cut-off criteria.
